# Coco Chess Engine

> Coco 2.0.0 is a free, GPL-3.0 UCI engine for standard chess and Chess960.
> Windows, Linux, and macOS executables embed the Ravager v3 NNUE network.

Coco runs in a UCI-compatible chess GUI such as Cutechess or Arena. It is
maintained by NotKaede-11. The embedded network and evaluator are credited to
erensh27.

## Download and setup

- [Homepage and setup](https://notkaede-11.github.io/coco-engine-website/#downloads): Build picker and UCI quick start.
- [Common questions](https://notkaede-11.github.io/coco-engine-website/#faq): GUI setup, CPU compatibility, and Chess960.
- [Coco 2.0.0 release](https://github.com/NotKaede-11/Coco-Engine/releases/tag/v2.0.0): Executables by OS and CPU.
- [CPU compatibility](https://github.com/NotKaede-11/Coco-Engine/blob/v2.0.0/README.md#choose-the-right-binary): Requirements for each build.

## Results and source

- [Tournament ratings](https://notkaede-11.github.io/coco-engine-website/#telemetry): CCRL and Chess Engines Diary entries by version.
- [Changelog and local match](https://github.com/NotKaede-11/Coco-Engine/blob/v2.0.0/CHANGELOG.md#200): Search changes and the 2.0 head-to-head result.
- [Coco 2.0.0 source](https://github.com/NotKaede-11/Coco-Engine/tree/v2.0.0): Versioned source and component notices.
- [Technical reference](https://notkaede-11.github.io/coco-engine-website/llms-full.txt): Evaluation, search, time management, and evidence.
